name.ja: ピカちんロボS04 ゴミバッコマン

description.ja: • 電子のパワーを秘めたピカちんキットSぞくぞく登場！
description.en: • Pikachin KitS, which has hidden electronic power, is here!

description.ja: • ゴミ箱センサー（別売）と合体して機能が拡張！センサーが反応するとゴミバッコマン登場音が流れる！
description.en: • Expands functionality by combining with trash can sensor (sold separately)! When the sensor reacts, the sound of Gomi Bakkoman appearing will be played!

description.ja: • 背中の車輪でころがし遊びができるアクション＆ギミック！
description.en: • Action and gimmick that allows you to roll it around with the wheels on the back!
